# Savelope

> Savelope is an iOS, iPadOS and macOS app for running the 100 envelope savings
> challenge. Each of the 100 envelopes holds a different whole-dollar amount
> between $1 and $100; you open one a day, set that amount aside yourself, and
> the full set adds up to exactly $5,050. Savelope never connects to a bank
> account and never moves money — it tells you what to set aside and keeps
> score. Free to use, with an optional Premium subscription.

## Key facts

- **Platforms:** iPhone, iPad and Mac (App Store).
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/id1578843165
- **Rating:** 4.8 from 442 ratings.
- **Price:** free. Premium is an optional subscription managed by Apple.
- **Bank access:** none. Savelope never asks for bank credentials and never
  moves money. The user transfers the amount themselves, to a savings account
  or to physical cash.
- **Data and privacy:** challenges live on the user's device and sync through
  their own iCloud account, so the developer cannot read them.
- **Why $5,050:** it is the sum of every whole number from 1 to 100.

## What it does

- **The classic challenge:** 100 envelopes, $1 to $100, in a random order,
  totalling $5,050.
- **Custom challenges:** any total and any number of envelopes, paced daily,
  weekly or monthly. A $1,000, $2,500 or $10,000 goal all work; the maths
  adjusts.
- **Four distribution modes:** random (for suspense), increasing (start
  gently), decreasing (front-load the big amounts), or equal.
- **Daily reminder:** one notification a day, at a time the user picks.
- **Shared challenges:** run one with family or friends, with synced progress.
- **Shareable progress images** for milestones.
- **Missing a day costs nothing.** Envelopes do not expire and there is no
  penalty or streak to break.

### Premium adds

- Unlimited simultaneous challenges
- Analytics: consistency, history and a calendar of every envelope opened
- Custom themes, including photo backgrounds
- Per-envelope notes
- Six alternate app icons

## Pages

- [Home](https://savelopeapp.com/): what the challenge is, how it works,
  features, and a FAQ.
- [The 100 Envelope Challenge](https://savelopeapp.com/100-envelope-challenge/):
  the full guide. Why the classic challenge totals $5,050 (it is the sum of 1 to
  100, or 50 pairs each worth $101), how long each pace takes, the total for
  every common envelope count from 25 to 200, which count to use for a given
  savings goal, the four ways to order the envelopes, a printable $1-$100 chart,
  and eight FAQs.
- [100 Envelope Challenge Calculator](https://savelopeapp.com/100-envelope-challenge-calculator/):
  a free tool. Give it a savings goal, an envelope count and a pace; it returns
  the amount in every envelope, the smallest, largest and average, how long the
  run takes and the finish date. Amounts keep the 1 : 2 : 3 … : n shape of the
  original challenge, scaled so they sum to the goal exactly. The page also
  shows the method worked by hand, so the arithmetic is readable without
  running the tool.
- [Savings Challenge Printables](https://savelopeapp.com/savings-challenge-printables/):
  four free printable charts - the 100 envelope challenge ($5,050), the 50
  envelope challenge ($1,275), the 52 week savings challenge ($1,378) and the
  26 week challenge ($351). No email address, account or download required.
  Each chart prints on its own page; printing the whole page gives all four,
  one per sheet.
- [Support](https://savelopeapp.com/support/): syncing, subscriptions, refunds,
  reminders, shared challenges, data deletion.
- [Privacy Policy](https://savelopeapp.com/privacy/): what stays on the device,
  what the app measures, which third-party services are involved.
- [Terms of Use](https://savelopeapp.com/terms/): subscription, billing and
  cancellation terms.
